name: Square Face Generator
tagline: Square Face Generator is a free online avatar maker inspired by classic Japanese icon tools like Picrew
description: Square Face Generator is a free online avatar maker inspired by classic Japanese icon tools like Picrew. It lets users create adorable, customizable square face icons using an HTML5-powered interface with 200+ items across 12 categories — hair, bangs, eyes, mouth, accessories, and more. The output is a crisp 256×256 PNG file ready for use as a profile picture on Discord, Twitter/X, TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube. No registration, no payment, and no software installation required. Works on desktop
